about: Shadow variants of tools/spoof_day.py, run beside the default on every daily day from 'from' to 'until' (tools/spoof_shadow.py; docs/spoofing-light-plan.md). 'set' holds detector constants; only settings inside spoof_day.py's ENVELOPE are allowed. List a variant here before scoring it, with the document that registers it.

variants.name: v0.6
variants.why: Calibration: the version v0.6.1 replaced, so the daily files show the shadow mechanism working against a known difference (docs/validation/spoofing-v061.md).

variants.name: carry-r3
variants.why: Pre-registered R3: an episode meeting the post rule is post even with peers when the aircraft's nearest earlier episode ended at most 3 h before and under 30 trusted minutes lie between (carried-over position error). Gates: H1-H3, H6, H8, C1, C2 over at least 14 days.
